B1_batch_builds_its_own_adapter._note: The regression the review of PR #4476 found unlocked: an adapter built here carries no cache-backed lookup index, so `create-batch` pays the cache read (the TBox filter still uses it) AND scans the corpus for every uid / label lookup — strictly worse than before this PR. No other axis can see it: they all drive `create`, whose fixtures were built for `create`, which is exactly the shape of integration-test-revert-verify §A122. C11 is the axis that does. ⛤ Type-preserving on purpose: the adapter is imported dynamically rather than through a top-level name this file no longer carries, so the mutant COMPILES and C11's red is a read-count difference — not a module that failed to load, which reads the same in the driver but means the opposite (integration-test-revert-verify §A97).
